wifiSetup.hint: Lets this computer reach the phone over Wi-Fi: turns on the phone's Wi-Fi connections setting and creates a pairing trust for Wi-Fi installs. Keep the phone unlocked and connected by USB. To undo, reset Location & Privacy on the phone.
wifiSetup.working: Setting up Wi-Fi… Keep the phone unlocked and connected by USB.
wifiSetup.done: Wi-Fi is set up. Refresh the device list to see the phone's Wi-Fi entry.

wifiRepair.title: Repair pairing for {{device}}
wifiRepair.explanation: Keep this selected device connected by USB. This renews this computer’s pairing with the phone and enables Wi-Fi connections. Existing app installations and separate RemotePairing data are kept.
wifiRepair.phonePrompt: Unlock the phone. If asked, tap Trust and enter the passcode on the phone. iLoader never asks for your phone passcode.
wifiRepair.retryLimit: The retry did not complete pairing. Close this dialog and check the phone before starting another repair.
wifiRepair.working: Requesting pairing and checking the USB connection. A request already sent to the phone must finish or time out before this dialog can close.
wifiRepair.stopping: Cancellation requested. If the phone accepts pairing, iLoader must save the new record before stopping. Waiting for the result…
wifiRepair.saved: The new pairing record was saved and read back, but USB verification or Wi-Fi settings did not finish. Reconnect and reselect the USB device before continuing.
wifiRepair.saveUnconfirmed: The phone accepted pairing, but saving or refreshing the host record could not be confirmed. Device selection was cleared. Keep USB connected and check pairing before installing or exporting.
wifiRepair.requestFailed: No reliable repair result was received. Pairing may have changed. Device selection was cleared; check the USB connection and reselect the phone before continuing.

status.completed: Pairing repaired. A fresh USB session authenticated and both Wi-Fi settings were verified. Wi-Fi services have not been tested yet: unplug USB, refresh devices, select Wi-Fi, then run the Wi-Fi connection check.
status.pending: The phone is waiting for Trust. Accept it and enter your passcode on the phone, then retry once.
status.locked: Unlock the phone and respond to any Trust prompt, then retry once.
status.denied: The phone declined pairing. No automatic retry will run.
status.deviceGone: The selected USB connection disappeared. Reconnect the phone and select its USB entry again.
status.wrongDevice: The USB device identity did not match the selection. Refresh devices and select the intended phone.
status.cancelled: Cancelled before sending a pairing request.
status.failed: Repair could not be prepared. Check USB and the existing host pairing record. This action does not replace missing or unreadable initial pairing records.
status.uncertain: The pairing reply was lost or timed out. The phone may have accepted it. Device selection was cleared; check the USB connection and pairing before continuing. No automatic retry will run.
status.partial: Pairing was accepted by the phone, but repair did not finish.

apps.title: Your apps
apps.subtitle: Install once. Keep the apps you choose renewed.
apps.consent: Install an iPhone app and renew it automatically over Wi-Fi using your saved account. Keep iLoader running and your PC awake.
apps.requirements: Sign in and select your iPhone over Wi-Fi to install a new app.
apps.unavailable: Automatic renewal is unavailable in this build. Install once remains available.
apps.host_paused: Automatic renewal is paused or off.
apps.action_failed: The action could not finish. Open View details to review the saved result.
apps.action_finished: App action finished. The status below reflects its renewal settings.
apps.install_finished: Installation finished. Check the app status below; existing global pause is preserved.
apps.already_managed: This exact IPA is already managed. Its pause and schedule were kept unchanged.
apps.catalog_busy: Installation in progress. The list will update when it finishes.
apps.empty_hint: Choose Install & auto-renew to add your first phone app.
apps.remove_explanation: Remove {{app}} from automatic renewal? Its installed app and your original IPA file stay in place.
apps.pending_explanation: The latest installation has not been fully committed. The profile below is historical; it does not prove which IPA is currently installed. Resume can finish an already validated installation without reinstalling. Otherwise review the outcome before recovery.
apps.recover_explanation: This explicit recovery attempts the currently retained IPA once. It can clear this app’s account stop only after validated success. A pending replacement is not automatically replayed.
apps.waiting_history: Phone locked or unreachable during connection check
apps.waiting_explanation: The phone was locked or unreachable before sign-in began. iLoader will retry at the next scheduled check while your PC is awake and automatic renewal is on. Unlocking does not trigger an immediate retry.
apps.waiting_paused: The phone was locked or unreachable before sign-in began. Automatic retry is paused; resume renewal to allow scheduled checks.
apps.evidence_hint: Expiry comes from the signed artifact, not a readback of the installed profile. No automatic status claims that you opened the app or verified its data. Watch automatic renewal remains unavailable.
apps.install_once_hint: For USB, Watch packages or a one-time install.
apps.recover_before_remove: Recover this account from View details before removing its failing app.
apps.startup: Start iLoader in the tray when I sign in to Windows
apps.startup_hint: Uses this copy of iLoader. Your renewal and pause settings stay unchanged. Windows may delay startup; check Windows Startup settings if it does not start.
apps.startup_read_failed: Windows startup status could not be read. Other renewal controls remain available.
apps.pause_finished: Paused. Any installation already in progress will finish.

session_cause.StorageDisabled: Secure credential storage is disabled. Review the storage preference before another attempt.
session_cause.PreferencesUnavailable: The secure-storage preference could not be read. Review settings before another attempt.
session_cause.CredentialNotFound: No credential entry was found for the saved account. No authentication was attempted.
session_cause.CredentialReadFailed: The credential entry could not be read. This does not prove the password is missing.
session_cause.CredentialAccessDenied: Secure storage denied access. No authentication was attempted.
session_cause.CredentialDecodeFailed: The credential entry could not be decoded. No authentication was attempted.
session_cause.CredentialEmpty: The saved credential entry was empty. No authentication was attempted.
session_cause.NetworkFailure: A network or HTTP-client operation failed at this stage. No automatic retry will run.
session_cause.HttpRejected: The service returned an HTTP error at this stage. No automatic retry will run.
session_cause.MfaRequired: The account requires an interactive step. Renewal stopped without requesting a verification code.
session_cause.RateLimited: The service rate-limited this attempt. Automatic authentication has stopped; the cooldown is unknown unless supplied by the service.
session_cause.AccountMismatch: The authenticated account or team did not match the saved setup. Review the setup before another attempt.
session_cause.TimedOut: The account session timed out at this stage. Review the result before another attempt.
session_cause.Unknown: This stage failed without a recognized error category. It does not prove credentials are missing. No automatic retry will run.

problem.WatchNotSupported: Watch saved renewal is not enabled in this build.
problem.DeviceLocked: Unlock the saved phone and choose Renew now when ready.
problem.Offline: The enrolled devices were unreachable. Check the local network, unlock the phone and keep the Watch nearby.
problem.MissingCredentials: Saved credentials could not be used. Review the account-session details before another attempt.
problem.AccountSessionFailed: The saved account session did not complete. Review its stage and result before another attempt.
problem.MfaRequired: Apple requires verification. Complete sign-in in the foreground before resuming.
problem.RateLimited: The service limited requests. Automatic authentication for this account has stopped; its cooldown is unknown.
problem.ArchiveMissing: The retained IPA is missing. Remove this setup and select the original IPA again.
problem.ArchiveChanged: The retained IPA no longer matches the saved original. Remove this setup and select the original IPA again.
problem.WrongDevice: The connected phone or Watch does not match this setup. Check the enrolled devices before resuming.
problem.Signing: Signing requires attention. Check the account, signing team and certificate in the foreground.
problem.Installation: Installation failed or its outcome is uncertain. Automatic retries have stopped; review the installed app before recovery.
problem.Interrupted: The previous attempt was interrupted. Check what is installed on each device before retrying; no automatic replay will run.
problem.UnknownExpiry: A device profile expiry is unknown. Confirm a manual renewal before enabling automatic attempts.
problem.TrustRequired: Existing device trust could not be reused. Complete device setup in the foreground.
problem.CertificateActionRequired: The saved signing certificate could not be reused. Check signing in the foreground.
problem.AccountMismatch: The saved account or signing team no longer matches this setup. Review the setup.
problem.LaunchConfirmationRequired: Complete a foreground renewal and confirm launch and retained data on every included device.

renewal.host_exiting: Waiting for active installation or renewal work to settle before exiting. Forced shutdown may leave an uncertain result.
renewal.close_to_tray: Keep iLoader running in the tray when I close the window
renewal.tray_enabled_hint: X hides the window only when the tray is available. Right-click the iLoader tray icon for Open iLoader, Pause/Resume renewals or Quit iLoader. Quit waits for active work and shows its status. Minimize still uses the taskbar. Opening iLoader yourself shows its window.
renewal.tray_disabled_hint: X quits after active work finishes. Close-to-tray is off until you explicitly select it. This preference does not enable renewals or Windows startup.

wifi.title: Renew over Wi-Fi
wifi.instructions: Disconnect USB, keep your trusted iPhone and Watch nearby, and refresh the device list. Choose the same original IPA used for the installed app. This action signs and installs it again. Nothing runs automatically.
wifi.select_direct: Select the phone's Wi-Fi entry. If it is missing, check the local network and existing pairing setup.
wifi.request_failed: The request could not complete. Reopen the app and check its state before trying again.
wifi.connected: iPhone Wi-Fi services confirmed for this attempt: authenticated identity, AFC read and installation service lookup passed. USB fallback is disabled.
wifi.not_connected: The Wi-Fi service check did not complete.
wifi.watch_connected: The separate Watch transport connected. See the installation results below.
wifi.watch_not_checked: This connection check does not verify Watch readiness, app signing or installation.

transport.appleDaemonNetwork: Route: Apple device service over Wi-Fi

connection_problem.wifiRequired: Select the phone's Wi-Fi entry; a USB connection cannot be used for this check.
connection_problem.networkDeviceUnavailable: Apple's device service did not provide one matching Network connection, or its handle changed. Keep the phone unlocked and refresh devices; no USB fallback was attempted.
connection_problem.savedPairingUnavailable: The saved host pairing record could not be read. Check existing USB setup before retrying; this check does not repair pairing.
connection_problem.trustRejected: The phone rejected the saved host pairing. No new pairing was attempted.
connection_problem.deviceLocked: Unlock the phone, then retry this read-only check.
connection_problem.wrongDevice: Authenticated phone identity did not match the selected phone. No installation was attempted.
connection_problem.timedOut: The displayed stage timed out. Keep the phone awake on the same network, refresh devices and retry.
connection_problem.serviceFailed: The displayed service stage failed. Copy this report for diagnosis; pairing was not changed.
connection_problem.watchTransportUnavailable: This IPA contains Watch content, but its separate transport was unavailable. Nothing was installed and Watch content was not removed. A successful iPhone check does not prove Watch readiness.

wifi.unavailable: Direct Wi-Fi connection was not confirmed. Refresh devices, check the same local network, unlock the iPhone, and verify existing pairing.
wifi.installation_library_code: Device-library error code: {{code}} / {{subcode}} (not an Apple service code)
wifi.installation_unclassified: The phone gave no recognized reason for the rejection. See the log for details.
wifi.installation_uncertain: The install request may have reached the phone before communication stopped. Check installed state before retrying; a visible icon alone does not prove installation or launch.

installStage.proxyInstall: Submit Install and await device completion

installCause.deviceRejected: The phone rejected an installer request. Review its error name and codes before changing the app or signing setup.
installCause.deviceLocked: The phone reported that it is locked. Installation did not complete.
installCause.developerModeDisabled: The phone reported that Developer Mode is disabled. Review that device setting before another attempt.
installCause.trustRejected: The phone rejected the saved trust/session. No new pairing was attempted.
installCause.wrongDevice: Authenticated phone identity changed. The connection was stopped.
installCause.timedOut: The displayed installation phase timed out. Review the phone state before retrying.
installCause.socket: Device communication stopped at the displayed phase. This does not establish an IPA or signature problem.
installCause.tls: The device service TLS connection failed at the displayed phase.
installCause.afc: The AFC upload service returned an error. Review its error name/code; device signature verification may not have started.
installCause.localFiles: A local signed-app file operation failed before installation completed.
installCause.protocol: The device reply could not be processed at the displayed phase.
installCause.deviceUnavailable: The required device or service was unavailable at the displayed phase.
installCause.unknown: The installer returned an unclassified failure. Copy the safe report; do not retry or change account settings blindly.

installContext.profileNotFound: Device description: a valid provisioning profile was not found.
installContext.invalidEntitlements: Device description: the executable has invalid entitlements.
installContext.signatureVersionUnsupported: Device description: the code signature version is unsupported.
installContext.signingIdentityInvalid: Device description: the signing identity is no longer valid.
installContext.freeAppLimit: Device description: the free developer app installation limit was reached.
installContext.developerModeDisabled: Device description: Developer Mode is disabled.
installContext.missingExecutableUuid: Device description: the executable has no LC_UUID load command.

signingCause.policyUnavailable: This build cannot enforce existing-certificate-only signing.
signingCause.savedKeyMissing: No saved private signing key is available to this app. An existing certificate alone is insufficient. Review the existing signing setup; no certificate was created or revoked.
signingCause.savedKeyUnavailable: The saved private signing key could not be read or decoded. Review secure storage access; no certificate was created or revoked.
signingCause.certificateLookupFailed: The existing signing certificate lookup failed. The reported service details may identify why; this does not prove the certificate is missing.
signingCause.certificateNotMatched: No existing certificate matched the saved signing key. Review the existing signing identity; no certificate was created or revoked.
signingCause.certificateInvalidValidity: The matching certificate is expired, not yet valid, or has unreadable validity dates. Review its validity before another attempt.
signingCause.certificateInactive: The matching certificate is revoked or its active status could not be confirmed. Review its status before another attempt.
signingCause.authentication: The displayed service rejected authentication or authorization. Review this stage and error code before changing account settings.
signingCause.accountLocked: The account service reported a locked account. Resolve that account condition before another attempt.
signingCause.developerRejected: The developer service rejected the request. Copy the report with its service code for diagnosis.
signingCause.anisetteUnavailable: Account request headers could not be obtained from the anisette provider. This alone does not establish a password or certificate problem. Copy this report for diagnosis.
signingCause.rateLimited: The displayed service returned HTTP 429 (rate limited). Stop repeated attempts and wait for the service limit to clear.
signingCause.httpRejected: The displayed service returned an unsuccessful HTTP status. Copy the report with its status code for diagnosis.
signingCause.remoteUnavailable: The displayed service returned a server error. Avoid repeated attempts while that service is unavailable.
signingCause.networkTimeout: A request timed out at the displayed signing stage. This does not establish a certificate or password problem.
signingCause.networkConnection: A network connection failed at the displayed signing stage. Copy this report before another attempt.
signingCause.invalidResponse: The displayed service returned data that could not be decoded. Copy this report for diagnosis.
signingCause.invalidBundle: The archive or app bundle could not be processed. Review the original IPA structure; do not change account settings based on this error.
signingCause.invalidExecutable: The signer rejected the app's Mach-O executable. Review the original test artifact; account changes will not repair its structure.
signingCause.signatureSpaceUnavailable: The unsigned executable lacks safe space for its signature load command. Rebuild the test artifact with sufficient header padding; do not change account settings.
signingCause.invalidProfile: The provisioning profile could not be processed. Copy this report for diagnosis before another attempt.
signingCause.codeSigningFailed: The local code-signing operation failed. Copy this report for diagnosis before changing account settings.
signingCause.localFiles: A local file operation failed during the displayed signing stage. Copy this report for diagnosis.
signingCause.secureStorage: Secure storage could not be accessed during the displayed signing stage. Review local credential-store access.
signingCause.unknown: The backend did not provide a recognized safe cause for this stage. Copy this report for diagnosis; do not repeat login, revoke certificates, or retry blindly.

wifi.evidence: These expiry dates come from the signed app, not a readback of the devices. Installed means the installer returned success. Verify that the app opens on both devices; Watch launch and survival beyond the previous expiry still need checking.

problem.wifiRequired: Select a direct Wi-Fi device. This action never falls back to USB.
problem.busy: Another installation is running, or the installation lock is unavailable. Wait for it to finish.
problem.connectionFailed: The Wi-Fi connection or local preparation failed. Check connectivity and pairing before trying again.
problem.signingFailed: Signing did not complete; installation was not attempted. Use the stage and cause above or copy the safe result report.
problem.iphoneFailed: iPhone installation was not confirmed. Review the installation stage, error and codes above; the Watch status remains separate.
problem.watchFailed: iPhone installation completed, but Watch installation did not. Keep the Watch nearby and available. Its renewal is not confirmed.
problem.localFiles: The app files could not be read. Choose the retained original IPA again.

pairing.name: Name
pairing.advanced_export_message: This is not recommended unless you know what you're doing. Press "Place" next to an app to transfer it automatically instead. Are you sure you still want to export your pairing file?

settings.reset_anisette_message: Are you sure you want to reset the anisette state? You will be required to enter your 2FA code again.
settings.delete_stored_rppairing_message: Are you sure you want to delete the stored pairing file for this device? This will require you to pair again.
settings.dont_use_keyring_message: This makes iloader less secure by storing pairing files, anisette state, and certificates on disk. Enable this only if the default keyring storage doesn't work and you understand the risks.

error.title: An Error Occured: {{msg}}

underage: Your Apple ID may be below the required age to use developer services.
account_locked: Don't panic! This usually occurs after multiple failed login attempts, but it is completely harmless.
auth: Make sure your credentials are correct and try again, even if they were correct.
If the issue persists, try using another Apple ID.
Security Key 2FA is not supported. If possible, use an Apple ID with no 2FA or with trusted device 2FA.
download: Download SideStore manually from ((link:https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/releases)) and use the "Import IPA" button to install it.
house_arrest: [ios::26.3]Ensure your device is not on a developer beta of iOS 26.3, as it has a bug with house arrest
pairing: Try reconnecting the device and running the action again.
Ensure your device has a passcode set.
Ensure your device is connected via USB, not wirelessly.
usbmuxd: [platform::windows]Ensure you have ((link:https://apple.co/ms:iTunes)) installed and check that it can detect your device.
[platform::windows]Uninstall iTunes and Apple Mobile Device Support, then install "Apple Devices" from the Microsoft Store.
[platform::linux]Make sure usbmuxd is installed and running.
trust: Unlock your device, go to the home screen, and accept any trust prompts that appear.
device_coms: Ensure your device is properly connected to your computer.
Unplug and reconnect the device. If the issue persists, try a different USB port and cable.
not_logged_in: Sign in to your Apple ID first.
anisette: Ensure your computer is connected to the internet.
Change your anisette server. Try several different servers.
Make sure you can access ((link:{{anisetteServerUrl}})) in a browser.
keyring: Try enabling "Don't use keyring" in settings to bypass this issue. Note that this is less secure.
misc: Try again. Restarting the app, your computer, and/or your phone may also help.
admin: Try running the app with elevated permissions (as administrator/root).
filesystem: Make sure iloader has permission to read and write files on your system.
not_enough_app_ids: You do not have enough App IDs available to install this app.
Wait for App IDs to expire after 7 days (cannot be deleted sooner), then try again.
Installing apps from SideStore sometimes allows you to use less App IDs, so try installing from there instead.
max_apps: You can only have 3 sideloaded apps installed at a time with a free Apple ID.
Delete other sideloaded apps to free up space for this one.
Expired apps still count towards the 3 app limit.

error.support_message: If the issue persists, press "Copy to clipboard" and send the copied error to the <discord>Discord</discord> or a <github>GitHub issue</github> for support.
